alias_policy: The default mobile catalog uses the alternatenames field already present in cities500.zip. alternateNamesV2.zip is optional and may be used when language-tagged alias enrichment is explicitly required; it must not become a runtime dependency.
build_strategy: Download a dated GeoNames source snapshot during controlled release preparation, record SHA-256 for every source artifact, generate a compact indexed UTF-8 catalog, record the generated catalog SHA-256, then bundle only the generated runtime catalog plus required attribution metadata in the application.
attribution_text: Geographical data © GeoNames, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
integrity_policy: The exact downloaded source artifacts and generated catalog must receive SHA-256 values before a release can mark the city dataset requirement DONE. A web listing observation alone is not physical artifact evidence.
